name: Ninetears
english_description: A Spanish-language LPMud (also called Driade / FFICMUD) run by "Alex"/"Tyrael" in the early 2000s, built on a FR (Final Realms) mudlib 3.4 base with substantial changes plus a few pieces from the Spanish Calandria-CLIB derivative, running on a patched MudOS v22 driver bundled in the repo (not used here -- this project's own FluffOS build is used instead). The repo's own README (English) frames it as the author's personal backup, released as-is; the archive's actual game content (room descriptions, commands, help text, in-game messages) is entirely in Spanish, contradicting an earlier research pass's 'English-language' classification -- confirmed by reading the raw source directly. A real, substantial multi-year archive: ~27,000 files/933K lines under the mudlib root, dozens of real wizard home directories (`w/<name>/`), a large domain tree (`d/<domain>/`) covering Urghak, Faeleen, Keroon, Asgard, Ishtar, Serkesh, and more, several guild systems (trolls, khurgars, chaos barbarians, jade knights), and real archived player save data. Source encoding is Windows-1252/Latin-1 (Spanish accented characters), not this project's usual GB18030 default -- an initial GB18030 pass produced silent CJK mojibake on ~940 files before this was caught and corrected. New-character registration is a real menu flow (name confirm, password, password confirm, gender) landing in "Plano Inmaterial" (a birth/soul-formation antechamber). Admin rank in this codebase is entirely name-based: `secure/bastards.lpc`'s `query_player_ob()` clones a DIFFERENT player body base class per rank (`/global/player`, `/global/creator`, `/global/lord`, `/global/god`, ...), each hardcoding its own `query_creator()`/`query_lord()`/`query_god()` to return 1, gated by name lookups against `secure/rango.lpc`'s data (a `dioses`/`semidioses`/`lords`/`thanes`/`patrones`/`regentes` mapping saved in `secure/rango.o`) plus a separate `secure/master.o` `positions` mapping (keyed by capitalized name) that drives `master.lpc`'s own `high_programmer()`/file-ACL checks -- two independently-gated admin mechanisms that both had to be seeded. Compiled clean on the first attempt: master.lpc, simul_efun.lpc, and every core base class (std/object, std/room, std/living/living, global/player) compiled with only harmless global-variable-redeclaration warnings, no errors. `/secure/ftpd` is preloaded and opens a real LISTENING socket on a hardcoded port (4001, `FR_FTP_PORT`) 2 seconds after boot for an in-game FTP-like file transfer feature -- a genuine additional network side effect, though inbound-listening rather than outbound-connecting.
